title: Event-Driven Architecture — Event Buses and Brokers
title_es: Arquitectura Event-Driven — Event Buses y Brokers
description: Runnable producer and consumer examples for event-driven systems: Kafka with Python, RabbitMQ with Node.js, AWS EventBridge with Terraform and TypeScript, Kafka Streams event sourcing in Java, and Avro with Schema Registry.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de productores y consumidores para sistemas event-driven: Kafka con Python, RabbitMQ con Node.js, AWS EventBridge con Terraform y TypeScript, event sourcing con Kafka Streams en Java, y Avro con Schema Registry.
